|translation='''Title:''' ComScan search.

'''Card text:'''
Use immediately after the opponent moves a character, vehicle or starship to a location as a 'react.' You may immediately move one of your vehicles or starships to that location, within landspeed or hyperspeed range. Spend Force for the move as usual.

'''Lore:'''
The Imperial Navy has the galaxy's finest communications network. Cutting-edge control technology lets it deploy forces without delay.
